en_title: Xbox Seeks Partner to Support Arkane Lyon as It Finishes Marvel's Blade, Extends Search for Buyer
cn_title: 微软为《漫威刀锋战士》寻合作方
subtitle: 寻找买家再宽限一个月
opus_summary: 微软正为Arkane Lyon寻找合作方，支持其完成《漫威刀锋战士》的开发，并将寻找买家的期限延长一个月。若找不到买家，工作室217名员工将面临失业风险。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft has said it's exploring the possibility of a company coming in to support Arkane Lyon as it works to finish development of Marvel's Blade, and that it's extending the deadline to find a buyer for the studio.
paragraphs.cn: 微软表示，正探索引入其他公司，支持Arkane Lyon完成《漫威刀锋战士》开发的可能性，同时延长为这家工作室寻找买家的期限。

paragraphs.en: Arkane Lyon's 217 employees are currently at risk of losing their jobs unless a buyer is found for the famed immersive sim studio. According to a recent report, Microsoft wanted to close the studio as part of its sweeping cuts in the summer, but French law prevented it from doing so straight away.
paragraphs.cn: 如果找不到买家，这家以沉浸式模拟游戏闻名的工作室旗下217名员工就将面临失业风险。据近期一篇报道，微软原本打算在夏季大规模削减业务时关闭这家工作室，但受法国法律限制，未能立即实施。

paragraphs.en: Following that report, which claimed Arkane had until November 13 to find a new owner, Microsoft has extended the deadline by a month. Additionally, it said it's looking for a partner to "support" Arkane, presumably with financing, for the final stretch of Marvel’s Blade's development.
paragraphs.cn: 此前的报道声称，Arkane必须在11月13日前找到新东家。报道发布后，微软将这一期限延长了一个月。此外，微软表示，正寻找合作方，在《漫威刀锋战士》开发的最后阶段为Arkane提供「支持」，推测可能是资金支持。

paragraphs.en: "We have extended the consultation period by one additional month as we explore options, including finding a partner to support the studio through the development work still ahead," a Microsoft representative told PC Gamer . "This is a defined extension, and we remain committed to keeping the Works Council informed throughout the process."
paragraphs.cn: 微软一位代表向PC Gamer表示：「我们已将协商期再延长一个月，以探索各种方案，包括寻找合作方，支持工作室完成接下来的开发工作。此次延期有明确期限，我们仍承诺在整个过程中向职工委员会通报进展。」

paragraphs.en: The studio was first informed of Microsoft’s decision on July 16, shortly after new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced similar plans for Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs — Ninja Theory was closed while the other studios went independent. Over 1,600 jobs were cut as part of the layoffs across Microsoft's gaming business. More followed, and more are to come.
paragraphs.cn: 工作室于7月16日首次获知微软的决定。就在此前不久，XBOX新任首席执行官Asha Sharma宣布了针对Compulsion Games、Double Fine Productions、Ninja Theory和Undead Labs的类似计划——Ninja Theory遭到关闭，其他工作室则转为独立运营。微软游戏业务的这轮裁员波及超过1,600个岗位，此后又有更多人遭到裁员，未来还将继续。

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg journalist Jason Schreier said he’d be surprised if Arkane Lyon ends up being shut down, however. “Let me share some positive news for a change,” he said on BlueSky . “Despite all the gloomy headlines today, my understanding is that there are multiple paths actively being explored that would save Arkane Lyon.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，彭博社记者Jason Schreier表示，如果Arkane Lyon最终被关闭，他会感到意外。他在BlueSky上写道：「这次换我来分享一点好消息。尽管今天的新闻标题都很悲观，但据我了解，各方正在积极探索多种能够保住Arkane Lyon的方案。」

paragraphs.en: “Anything can happen during negotiations, but at this point I'd be surprised if the studio is shut down. One important piece of context that many people might not realize: Shutting down a game studio is expensive. Shutting down a French game studio — thanks to labor laws requiring an extended severance period — is VERY expensive. Xbox doesn't want to take on those costs.”
paragraphs.cn: 「谈判过程中什么都有可能发生，但就目前而言，如果工作室被关闭，我会感到意外。许多人可能没有意识到一个重要背景：关闭一家游戏工作室的成本很高。而关闭一家法国游戏工作室，成本更是高得惊人，因为当地劳动法要求较长的离职补偿期。XBOX不想承担这些费用。」

paragraphs.en: The union is currently pushing for re-employment of affected staff to other studios within Xbox, should Microsoft fail to secure a deal for Arkane Lyon to survive. "The redundancy plan must be adapted to the video game market where, currently, the prospects for returning to work are extremely limited,” said a union rep.
paragraphs.cn: 工会目前正争取让受影响的员工转岗至XBOX旗下其他工作室，以应对微软无法达成协议、保住Arkane Lyon的情况。一位工会代表表示：「裁员方案必须考虑电子游戏行业的就业市场现状，目前重新就业的机会极其有限。」

paragraphs.en: Negotiations are ongoing, but the union hasn’t ruled out seeing Microsoft in court. "Microsoft is looking to divest itself of Arkane, even though the studio is doing well, in order to save money and improve the profitability of its short-term investments," said the rep.
paragraphs.cn: 谈判仍在继续，但工会并未排除与微软对簿公堂的可能。这位代表表示：「尽管Arkane运营状况良好，微软仍想将其剥离，以节省开支，提高短期投资的盈利能力。」

paragraphs.en: Marvel’s Blade was on track for a reveal early next year and a release in the fourth quarter of 2027, IGN understands. Blade was announced in December 2023 with a reveal trailer, but we've seen nothing of it since. In June, Bethesda Game Studios head Todd Howard was quoted as saying he'd recently seen what Arkane Lyon was cooking up and was impressed . "I'm not at liberty to say when [we'll see more]," Howard teased at the time, "but I saw some stuff just yesterday [on May 21] and the folks at Arkane [Studios, the developers] are doing a really, really great job."
paragraphs.cn: 据IGN了解，《漫威刀锋战士》此前按计划推进，预计明年初展示，并于2027年第四季度发售。该作于2023年12月通过一支首曝预告片正式公布，但此后我们就再没见过新内容。6月，有报道援引贝塞斯达游戏工作室负责人陶德·霍华德的话称，他近期看过Arkane Lyon正在开发的内容，印象深刻。霍华德当时卖了个关子：「我不便透露（我们何时能看到更多），但我昨天（5月21日）刚看到一些内容，Arkane（工作室，开发商）的伙计们干得真的非常、非常出色。」
